d:
Hi everyone back again with part 2 of my new comic, I was disappointed in the lack of control over fluids and the slow ass rendering time within Daz and after researching ways to achieve this I landed on blender. I am able to import my scenes into blender for final touch ups and rendering. Naturally this introduced a whole shit ton of technical issues that took me forever to resolve but I feel I am getting the hang off the basics.

This one has much better lighting except for one page which I couldn't fix due to not having the scene anymore and am happy with the result.

I am not sure if I am going to continue this comic or start another one, this comic was essentially a tech demo to see if this was a viable path to go down.

I have a question for you, would you still like to see AI generated content from time to time? I somewhat miss the anime style haha

I have started a Patreon. Now that I am going down Daz/Blender I feel comfortable starting one, nothing I am working on is a Patreon exclusive so don't feel the need to subscribe. All comics will be eventually released on here
https://patreon.com/Futaloverxxx
